changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION [metrics].[AssetsMeetConditions] ( @assetTypeUid uniqueidentifier, @assetUid uniqueidentifier, @effectiveDate date ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select A.Uid, MV.EffectiveDate from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.Uid = @assetTypeUid and T.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.Uid = @assetUid inner join dbo.FieldType FT on FT.Object = T.Object and FT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and FT.[Type] in ('Boolean', 'Date', 'DateTime', 'Decimal', 'Html', 'Link', 'Lookup', 'Number', 'Percentage', 'Text') left join dbo.Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.ObjectType = A.Object and F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID inner join metrics.Asset M on M.AssetTypeUid = T.[Uid] and M.IsGroup = 0 and M.State = 1 inner join metrics.AssetVersion MV on MV.[Uid] = M.[Uid] and MV.EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate left join metrics.AssetVersionCondition C on C.[Uid] = M.[Uid] and C.EffectiveDate = MV.EffectiveDate and C.FieldTypeID = FT.ID left join ( select A.Uid, MV.EffectiveDate from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetType T on T.Uid = @assetTypeUid and T.ID = A.AssetTypeID and A.Uid = @assetUid inner join dbo.FieldType FT on FT.Object = T.Object and FT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and FT.[Type] in ('Boolean', 'Date', 'DateTime', 'Decimal', 'Html', 'Link', 'Lookup', 'Number', 'Percentage', 'Text') left join dbo.Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.ObjectType = A.Object and F.ObjectID = A.ObjectID inner join metrics.Asset M on M.AssetTypeUid = T.[Uid] and M.IsGroup = 0 and M.State = 1 inner join metrics.AssetVersion MV on MV.[Uid] = M.[Uid] and MV.EffectiveDate = @effectiveDate inner join metrics.AssetVersionCondition C on C.[Uid] = M.[Uid] and C.EffectiveDate = MV.EffectiveDate and C.FieldTypeID = FT.ID where metrics.CompareConditionValueToFieldValue(FT.[Type], C.Operator, C.ValueJson, coalesce(F.Value, FT.DefaultValue)) = 0 group by A.Uid, MV.EffectiveDate ) B on B.uid = A.Uid and B.EffectiveDate = MV.EffectiveDate where ( ( C.Uid is not null and F.ID is not null and metrics.CompareConditionValueToFieldValue(FT.[Type], C.Operator, C.ValueJson, coalesce(F.Value, FT.DefaultValue)) = 1 ) or C.Uid is null ) and B.Uid is null group by A.Uid, MV.EffectiveDate )
